title: Gestational diabetes mellitus and development of intergenerational overall and subtypes of cardiovascular diseases: a systematic review and meta-analysis
abstract: This systematic review synthesizes evidence on the association between gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and the long-term development of cardiovascular diseases (CVD) in mothers and offspring post-delivery.
objective: To quantify the association between GDM and subsequent overall and subtype-specific cardiovascular diseases in both mothers and offspring.
method: Cohort and case-control studies reporting CVD outcomes after a GDM pregnancy are eligible. Studies without a non-GDM comparator, or reporting only in-pregnancy outcomes, are excluded.
